exposure: Early amniotomy (artificial rupture of membranes at 3 cm cervical dilation)
outcome: Proportion of women who delivered within 24 hours
cohort: 200 term pregnant women at Zeynep Kamil Maternity and Children's Training and Research Hospital
finding: Early amniotomy, after ripening with a dinoprostone insert, significantly reduced the duration of labor and increased the rate of delivery within 24 hours without increasing Cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Early amniotomy, after ripening with a dinoprostone insert, was associated with shorter labor duration and a higher frequency of vaginal delivery within 24 hours.
